Subject: Sessionized stream profile & SLA alignment (FastShip pilot)

Hi Alice — great speaking earlier. Recap of requirements and numbers we captured on the call:

- Session characteristics:
  - Interactive voice-to-text → streaming assistant; session durations typically 30–90s, median ~45s.
  - Partial results streamed every 800–1200ms; client expects first partial within 150ms for short prompts.
- Throughput / concurrency:
  - Concurrent active streaming sessions observed during peak: ~120
  - Steady-state concurrent: ~25–35
  - Average token emission per session: 35 tokens/sec (range 10–75)
  - Expected peak rate (peak window 60s): up to 6000 tokens/sec aggregated
  - Steady aggregate: ~900 tokens/sec
- Latency targets:
  - First-token p95 target: 150ms
  - Per-token p95 during streaming: 300ms
- Misc:
  - Payloads typically 1–2KB metadata + audio chunk references.
  - Retries: client will backoff aggressively; expect transient reconnects.

As next steps I recommend:
1) You confirm the sample payloads attached and provide a small anonymized session trace (we can use the jsonl you mentioned).
2) Permission to run a short noise test (5k synthetic streaming tokens over 15 minutes) to validate p95 first-token under burst.
3) Agree on pilot sizing: our initial suggestion is a 4-GPU dedicated pool with low-latency streaming profile (details attached).

I've attached a session_profile csv that mirrors the numbers above and added a HubSpot link below. If that matches, we can schedule a 30m technical onboarding this week to lock down the canary plan.

Best,

Thanks — attaching a short pilot proposal.

High-level mapping to your canary plan:
- Canary 5% (internal beta): route to dedicated pool with conservative batching (disabled for first-token), pre-warmed KV caches, and stream-only execution path.
- Canary 25%: enable adaptive small-window batching for background tokens (not first-token), scale pool to 3-4 GPUs.
- Full rollout: scale to 6 GPUs if sustained 150 concurrent sessions observed.

Pilot sizing assumptions:
- 4 x A100-sim (dedicated) expected to keep p95 first-token <=150ms for up to 140 concurrent sessions with our streaming path; for spikes to 150-180 concurrent we recommend burst capacity + autoscale to 6 GPUs.
- Canary rollback trigger: p95 first-token >225ms for more than 5 minutes.

Next steps:
- We run the 15-minute noise test this Friday (Jun 11) at 10:00 PT — ok?
- We'll provision a temporary pilot tenant and send a DocuSign for the pilot order.
- Jordan will follow up with a draft quote and MD for the dedicated pilot.
